<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL"
                  xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance"
                  id="Definitions_Chainsaw"
                  targetNamespace="http://example.com/bpmn/chainsaw">
  <bpmn:message id="Message_ChainsawProperties" name="Chainsaw properties"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_CustomerUpdate" name="Production update"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_FirstSaw" name="First saw"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_CustomerFeedback" name="Feedback on first saw"/>

  <bpmn:process id="Process_ChainsawProduction" name="Chainsaw production" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="StartEvent_Properties" name="Customer provides chainsaw properties">
      <bpmn:documentation>The customer specifies at least five properties, such as guide bar length (Schwertlaenge), chain width, and electric or motor chainsaw.</bpmn:documentation>
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MessageEventDefinition_Properties" messageRef="Message_ChainsawProperties"/>
    </bpmn:startEvent>

    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_ProductionAndUpdates_Split" name="Produce and send updates in parallel"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_OrderParts" name="Order parts from online sources">
      <bpmn:multiInstanceLoopCharacteristics isSequential="false"/>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_ReceiveParts" name="Receive ordered parts"/>
    <bpmn:manualTask id="Task_InspectParts" name="Manually inspect all parts"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_AssembleFirstSaw" name="Assemble first saw"/>

    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_SendUpdates" name="Send regular customer updates" messageRef="Message_CustomerUpdate">
      <bpmn:standardLoopCharacteristics testBefore="false">
        <bpmn:loopCondition xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">First saw production is ongoing</bpmn:loopCondition>
      </bpmn:standardLoopCharacteristics>
    </bpmn:sendTask>
    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_ProductionAndUpdates_Join" name="First saw ready and updates complete"/>

    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_SendFirstSaw" name="Send first saw to customer" messageRef="Message_FirstSaw"/>
    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="Event_CatchFeedback" name="Receive customer feedback">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MessageEventDefinition_CustomerFeedback" messageRef="Message_CustomerFeedback"/>
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_FirstSawLiked" name="Does the customer like the first saw?" default="Flow_NotLiked"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_ProduceRemainingSaws" name="Produce the rest of the order"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_OrderProduced" name="Order produced"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_NotContinued" name="No further saws produced"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Start_ToSplit" sourceRef="StartEvent_Properties" targetRef="Gateway_ProductionAndUpdates_Split"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Split_ToOrderParts" sourceRef="Gateway_ProductionAndUpdates_Split" targetRef="Task_OrderParts"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_OrderParts_ToReceive" sourceRef="Task_OrderParts" targetRef="Task_ReceiveParts"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Receive_ToInspect" sourceRef="Task_ReceiveParts" targetRef="Task_InspectParts"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Inspect_ToAssemble" sourceRef="Task_InspectParts" targetRef="Task_AssembleFirstSaw"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Assemble_ToJoin" sourceRef="Task_AssembleFirstSaw" targetRef="Gateway_ProductionAndUpdates_Join"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Split_ToUpdates" sourceRef="Gateway_ProductionAndUpdates_Split" targetRef="Task_SendUpdates"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Updates_ToJoin" sourceRef="Task_SendUpdates" targetRef="Gateway_ProductionAndUpdates_Join"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Join_ToSendFirstSaw" sourceRef="Gateway_ProductionAndUpdates_Join" targetRef="Task_SendFirstSaw"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_SendFirstSaw_ToFeedback" sourceRef="Task_SendFirstSaw" targetRef="Event_CatchFeedback"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Feedback_ToDecision" sourceRef="Event_CatchFeedback" targetRef="Gateway_FirstSawLiked"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Liked_ToProduceRest" name="Likes it" sourceRef="Gateway_FirstSawLiked" targetRef="Task_ProduceRemainingSaws">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">Customer likes the first saw</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ProduceRest_ToEnd" sourceRef="Task_ProduceRemainingSaws" targetRef="EndEvent_OrderProduced"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_NotLiked" name="Does not like it" sourceRef="Gateway_FirstSawLiked" targetRef="EndEvent_NotContinued"/>
  </bpmn:process>

  <bpmn:collaboration id="Collaboration_Chainsaw">
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Producer" name="Chainsaw producer" processRef="Process_ChainsawProduction"/>
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Customer" name="Customer"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_CustomerProperties" name="Chainsaw properties" sourceRef="Participant_Customer" targetRef="StartEvent_Properties" messageRef="Message_ChainsawProperties"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_UpdatesToCustomer" name="Production updates" sourceRef="Task_SendUpdates" targetRef="Participant_Customer" messageRef="Message_CustomerUpdate"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_FirstSawToCustomer" name="First saw" sourceRef="Task_SendFirstSaw" targetRef="Participant_Customer" messageRef="Message_FirstSaw"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_CustomerFeedback" name="Feedback on first saw" sourceRef="Participant_Customer" targetRef="Event_CatchFeedback" messageRef="Message_CustomerFeedback"/>
  </bpmn:collaboration>
</bpmn:definitions>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Assemble_ToJoin" sourceRef="Task_AssembleFirstSaw" targetRef="Gateway_ProductionUpdates_Join"/>

    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_Production_Join" name="First saw assembled and updates sent">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_AssembleFirstSaw_ToProductionJoin</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_SendUpdates_ToProductionJoin</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_ProductionJoin_ToSendFirstSaw</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:parallelGateway>

    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_SendFirstSaw" name="Send the first saw to the customer" messageRef="Message_FirstSaw">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_ProductionJoin_ToSendFirstSaw</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_SendFirstSaw_ToFeedback</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:sendTask>

    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="Event_CatchFeedback" name="Receive customer feedback on the first saw">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_SendFirstSaw_ToFeedback</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Feedback_ToDecision</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MessageEventDefinition_CustomerFeedback" messageRef="Message_CustomerFeedback"/>
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>

    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_FirstSawLiked" name="Does the customer like the first saw?" default="Flow_NotLiked"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_ProduceRemainingSaws" name="Produce the rest of the order">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Liked_ToProduceRest</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_ProduceRest_ToEnd</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>

    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_OrderProduced" name="Rest of the order produced">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_ProduceRest_ToEnd</bpmn:incoming>
    </bpmn:endEvent>

    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_NotContinued" name="Rest of the order not produced">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_NotLiked</bpmn:incoming>
    </bpmn:endEvent>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Start_ToRecordProperties" sourceRef="StartEvent_Properties" targetRef="Task_RecordProperties"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_RecordProperties_ToOrderParts" sourceRef="Task_RecordProperties" targetRef="Task_OrderParts"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_OrderParts_ToReceiveParts" sourceRef="Task_OrderParts" targetRef="Task_ReceiveParts"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ReceiveParts_ToInspect" sourceRef="Task_ReceiveParts" targetRef="Task_InspectParts"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Inspect_ToProductionSplit" sourceRef="Task_InspectParts" targetRef="Gateway_Production_Split"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Split_ToAssembleFirstSaw" sourceRef="Gateway_Production_Split" targetRef="Task_AssembleFirstSaw"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Split_ToSendUpdates" sourceRef="Gateway_Production_Split" targetRef="Task_SendUpdates"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_AssembleFirstSaw_ToProductionJoin" sourceRef="Task_AssembleFirstSaw" targetRef="Gateway_Production_Join"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_SendUpdates_ToProductionJoin" sourceRef="Task_SendUpdates" targetRef="Gateway_Production_Join"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ProductionJoin_ToSendFirstSaw" sourceRef="Gateway_Production_Join" targetRef="Task_SendFirstSaw"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_SendFirstSaw_ToFeedback" sourceRef="Task_SendFirstSaw" targetRef="Event_CatchFeedback"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Feedback_ToDecision" sourceRef="Event_CatchFeedback" targetRef="Gateway_FirstSawLiked"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Liked_ToProduceRest" name="Customer likes it" sourceRef="Gateway_FirstSawLiked" targetRef="Task_ProduceRemainingSaws">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">customerLikesFirstSaw</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ProduceRest_ToEnd" sourceRef="Task_ProduceRemainingSaws" targetRef="EndEvent_OrderProduced"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_NotLiked" name="Customer does not like it" sourceRef="Gateway_FirstSawLiked" targetRef="EndEvent_NotContinued"/>
  </bpmn:process>

  <bpmn:collaboration id="Collaboration_Chainsaw">
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Producer" name="Chainsaw producer" processRef="Process_ChainsawProduction"/>
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Customer" name="Customer"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_CustomerProperties" name="Chainsaw properties" sourceRef="Participant_Customer" targetRef="StartEvent_Properties" messageRef="Message_ChainsawProperties"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_UpdatesToCustomer" name="Production updates" sourceRef="Task_SendUpdates" targetRef="Participant_Customer" messageRef="Message_CustomerUpdate"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_FirstSawToCustomer" name="First saw" sourceRef="Task_SendFirstSaw" targetRef="Participant_Customer" messageRef="Message_FirstSaw"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_CustomerFeedback" name="Feedback on first saw" sourceRef="Participant_Customer" targetRef="Event_CatchFeedback" messageRef="Message_CustomerFeedback"/>
  </bpmn:collaboration>
</bpmn:definitions>
